dialect.detail: Micro Focus COBOL using VPLUS/SP2 GUI library (HP VPLUS or compatible screen management system); uses COMP-5, free-format source directive, COPY 'vplus/SP250', COPY 'vplus/COMAREA', COPY 'vplus/VPLUSMEM'

purpose.domain_detail: GUI popup message dialog utility for VPLUS/SP2 windowing environment; callable subprogram that displays a configurable popup message box with buttons (OK, Yes/No, Retry/Cancel) and returns user response
purpose.summary: VPOPUPMSG is a reusable subprogram that creates and manages a GUI popup message dialog using the VPLUS SP2 windowing API. It accepts a message (up to 4 lines), a dialog type (bang/stop/info/question), button configuration (OK, Yes/No, No/Yes, Retry/Cancel), optional Cancel button, and a timeout. It opens a window, creates a panel, adds static text fields and push buttons, conducts a conversation loop, and returns the user's button choice via VP-Reply.

notable_features: VPLUS/SP2 GUI windowing API (SP2-OPEN-WINDOW, SP2-SET-PANEL-DEF, SP2-SET-FIELD-DEF, SP2-SET-STATIC-DEF)
COPY of vplus/SP250, vplus/COMAREA, vplus/VPLUSMEM copybooks
LINKAGE SECTION with COMAREA and VPOPUP parameters
88-level condition names for button types and replies
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING with named parameters
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; the VPOPUP-Conversation paragraph is cut off mid-line. The SP2 API is characteristic of HP VPLUS or a Micro Focus VPLUS-compatible GUI library. No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL present. The program is a well-structured, parameterized utility subprogram consistent with production use.
